mapping: Flat source nodes preserve keyword presence and parsed values; properties and items hold source-stable child IDs. Enum rows preserve exact contextual values and definitions. Rules are descriptive and never executable.
source_authority: Merged schema is the structural authority, independently reconciled with base, enum and labels. Source revision is 1.4.2; the retained schema_version default remains 1.4.0. Guide v3.0 targets 1.4.1 and VCDB examples; it cannot change Community 1.4.2 vocabulary.
identity: veris-<kind>-SHA256(JCS([veris-community,kind,pointer])) for nodes; append exact string enum value for enum-value; use stable curated rule_id for semantic-rule.
normalization: Native values and optional-member presence are preserved. Display uses decoded HTML text, whitespace normalization and NFC, never truncation. Qualified aliases colliding under NFC/ASCII folding are excluded from every owner.
relationship: contains, has-item-schema, allows-value and governed-by-rule; exact source refs and RP-REQ-111 identity; no inferred transitive edges.
network: Acquisition only. Projection, package publication, runtime and tests are offline.
licensing: CC-BY-SA-4.0 with exact license and attribution; distributable assembly requires the explicit project disposition.
